description: This file implements the <calculate> element for a mini-language, providing arithmetic operations and type conversions within a custom scripting context in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Calculate
classes.description: Main class implementing the <calculate> element, supporting arithmetic operations, type conversions, and formatting.
